label: GoDaddy Backup - Test & Validate
info:
Companion test flow for godaddy_backup_flow.json (PLAN.md §2's standing rule: every live flow gets one — this one was originally missing, flagged as a gap, now built). Exercises the SQLite-serialization half of that flow in isolation, against a hand-built fixture standing in for a pull_manual_data.php response, using the SAME row-building code (record_type filter + SQL string-escaping + JSON.stringify) duplicated verbatim from n_gb_process — not a reimplementation that could quietly drift from what the real flow actually runs.

What it checks, against a throwaway scratch table (godaddy_backup_test) in the same scratch DB file sqlite_test_flow.json already uses (/share/lucius_sqlite_test.db) — never touches the real /share/lucius_godaddy_backup.db:
1. Round-trip fidelity: five in-scope record types (incident, daily_log, therapy_session, medication, medication_dosage_history), each carrying deliberately awkward content — embedded single quotes, double quotes, a literal SQL-comment sequence, a newline, and non-ASCII text — survive CREATE→escape→INSERT OR REPLACE→SELECT→JSON.parse exactly unchanged.
2. Scope filtering: an ecg_recording fixture and a made-up future record_type are correctly EXCLUDED from what gets written — confirms the real flow's inScope allowlist actually works, not just that it exists in the code.
3. Natural-key behavior: two fixture rows sharing the same (record_type, source_id) — simulating a re-run backing up the same GoDaddy id twice — collapse to one row (INSERT OR REPLACE), not two.

Does NOT exercise the HTTP/secrets/InfluxDB half of the real flow — that logic is identical to godaddy_pull_flow.json's own already-relied-upon pattern, not new here. Also does not call the real GoDaddy API or write real InfluxDB points, by design — this is offline/isolated, same as every other companion test flow in this project.

UNTESTED like every other flow in this project — the SQLite CREATE/INSERT/SELECT/DROP sequence and node-red-node-sqlite's query/result shape ARE separately confirmed against Ward's real instance (sqlite_test_flow.json Part A), so this flow's own mechanics carry high confidence; what's specifically unverified is this flow itself, end to end, on a real deploy.
